footHTML: OpenStreetMap data as of October 9, 2026, filtered to 24,589 miles of protected paths from Maine to Virginia and west through Ohio: all of New England, New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Delaware, Maryland, DC, Virginia, West Virginia and Ohio. Likely singletrack and hiking trails (3,750 mi) are kept in the Other trails layer instead. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. Terrain from Mapzen/AWS Terrain Tiles. Click any line for its tags and a link to edit it in OpenStreetMap.
